rules.title: Pictures with no description
rules.message: This picture has no description and is not marked as decorative.
rules.fix: Write a short description of what the picture shows or does, or mark it as decorative if it adds nothing.

rules.title: Descriptions that say nothing about the picture
rules.message: This picture's description says nothing about it: "{alt}".
rules.fix: Replace the description with words that say what the picture shows or does.

rules.title: Decorative pictures that also have a description
rules.message: This picture is marked as decorative but also has a description.
rules.fix: Remove the description, or stop marking the picture as decorative.

rules.title: Headings with no words
rules.message: This heading has no words.
rules.fix: Write the heading's words, or make it ordinary text.

rules.title: Headings that skip a level
rules.message: A level {level} heading follows a level {previous} heading, so a level is skipped.
rules.fix: Use level {expected} here, or change the headings so that none is skipped.

rules.title: Headings that do not start at level 1
rules.message: The first heading is level {level}, not level 1.
rules.fix: Make the main heading level 1.

rules.title: Documents that do not say their language
rules.message: The {what} does not say what language it is in.

variants.invalid: The {what} says its language is "{lang}", which is not a language tag.

rules.fix: Set the language (such as en or en-US).

rules.title: Documents with no title
rules.message: The {what} has no title.
rules.fix: Give it a title that says what it is about.

rules.title: PDFs that show their file name instead of their title
rules.message: The PDF shows its file name in the title bar instead of its title.
rules.fix: Make the PDF with "Display document title" (DisplayDocTitle) turned on.

rules.title: PDFs with no tags
rules.message: The PDF has no tags, so a screen reader cannot tell headings, lists or pictures from other text.
rules.fix: Make the PDF again with tags turned on (a tagged PDF).

rules.title: Buttons and fields with no name
rules.message: This {role} has no name, so a screen reader cannot say what it is.
rules.fix: Give it a visible label, or a name for screen readers (aria-label).

rules.title: Links with no words
rules.message: This link has no words, so a screen reader cannot say where it goes.
rules.fix: Put words in the link that say where it goes.

rules.title: Links whose words say nothing about where they go
rules.message: This link says only "{text}", which says nothing about where it goes.
rules.fix: Use words that say where the link goes, such as the title of the page it opens.

rules.title: Ids used more than once
rules.message: The id "{id}" is used {count} times; each id may be used only once.
rules.fix: Give each element its own id, and update anything that refers to it.

rules.title: References to ids that are not there
rules.message: {attribute} refers to "{id}", which is not on the page.
rules.fix: Point it at an element that is there, or remove the reference.

rules.title: Roles that do not exist
rules.message: The role "{role}" does not exist, so screen readers ignore it.
rules.fix: Use one of the ARIA roles, or remove the role.

rules.title: Pages with no main part
rules.message: The page has no main part (a main element).
rules.fix: Put the page's own content in a main element.

rules.title: Pages with no way to skip past repeated parts
rules.message: The page repeats a navigation block and has no way to skip past it: no main part, no headings and no skip link.

variants.skip-target: The link that skips to the content goes to "#{id}", which is not on the page.

rules.fix: Add a link at the top that skips to the content, or a main element and headings.

rules.title: Text whose colours are too close
rules.message: {foreground} on {background} is {ratio} to 1; {size} text needs at least {minimum} to 1.

variants.uncertain-bold: {foreground} on {background} is {ratio} to 1, which is enough only if the text is bold, and it could not be told whether it is.
variants.unknown-background: The text's colour is {foreground}, but what is behind it (a picture or a gradient) could not be measured.

rules.fix: Make the text darker or its background lighter (or the other way round) until they reach {minimum} to 1.

rules.title: Marks and controls whose colours are too close
rules.message: {foreground} against {background} is {ratio} to 1; a mark or a control needs at least 3 to 1.
rules.fix: Choose colours further apart until they reach 3 to 1.

rules.title: Things that can be clicked but not reached with the keyboard
rules.message: This {what} reacts to a click but cannot be reached with the Tab key.

variants.removed: This {what} has been taken out of the Tab order (tabindex -1).

rules.fix: Use a button or a link, or make it reachable with tabindex="0".

rules.title: Things that react to a click but not to a key
rules.message: This {what} reacts to a click but not to Enter or Space.
rules.fix: Make Enter and Space do what a click does, or use a real button.

rules.title: A Tab order that may be out of order
rules.message: This sets its own place in the Tab order (tabindex {tabindex}), which usually puts it out of order.

variants.duplicate: {count} things share place {order} in the Tab order, so the order between them is not fixed.

rules.fix: Let the Tab order follow the reading order: remove the positive tabindex, or give each thing its own place.

rules.title: A Tab order with gaps
rules.message: The Tab order has gaps: {gaps}.
rules.fix: Number the Tab order 1, 2, 3 and so on with no gaps.

rules.title: Styles that hide where the keyboard is
rules.message: A style rule ({selector}) takes away the focus outline without showing focus another way.
rules.fix: Keep the outline, or show focus another way: a border, a shadow or a background.

rules.title: Videos with no captions
rules.message: This video has no captions.

variants.embedded: This embedded video keeps its captions where it is hosted, so they cannot be checked here.
variants.unknown: This video's captions could not be checked.

rules.fix: Add a captions track (a WebVTT file), or turn captions on where the video is hosted.

rules.title: Sound with no transcript
rules.message: This sound has no transcript that could be found.
rules.fix: Put a transcript next to it, or a link to one.

rules.title: Videos with no audio description
rules.message: This video has no audio description track. If it shows things that the sound does not say, it needs one.
rules.fix: Add a description track, or a version of the video whose narration says what is shown.

rules.title: Sound that plays by itself
rules.message: This {what} plays sound by itself when the page opens.
rules.fix: Do not start it by itself, or start it muted.

rules.title: Content that moves on or ends on a timer
rules.message: This content moves on or ends on a timer.

variants.refresh: The page reloads or moves on by itself after {seconds} seconds.
variants.moving: A {element} element moves or blinks its text with no way to stop it.

rules.fix: Let people turn off, extend or pause the time limit or the movement.

rules.title: Tables with no header cells
rules.message: This table has no header cells, so a screen reader cannot say which row or column a cell is in.
rules.fix: Mark the first row (or the first column) as header cells.

rules.title: Long documents with no contents list or bookmarks
rules.message: The {what} has no contents list or bookmarks.
rules.fix: Make the document with bookmarks, or a contents list, made from its headings.

rules.title: Slides with no title
rules.message: Slide {slide} has no title.
rules.fix: Give the slide a title. It can be placed off the slide if it should not be seen.

rules.title: E-books that do not describe their accessibility
rules.message: The e-book does not describe its own accessibility (it has no {missing}).
rules.fix: Add the accessibility details to the package file: access mode, features, hazards and a summary.

rules.title: Captions files that cannot be read
rules.message: The captions file cannot be read: {detail}.
rules.fix: Save the captions again as WebVTT.

rules.title: Captions that are hard to read in time
rules.message: This caption shows {rate} characters a second; more than {limit} is hard to read in time.

variants.line: A line of this caption is {length} characters long; more than {limit} is hard to read in time.
variants.lines: This caption has {lines} lines; more than {limit} covers too much of the picture.
variants.overlap: This caption starts before the one before it ends.

rules.fix: Split long captions, or show each one for longer.

rules.title: Check the reading order
rules.message: Listen to it with a screen reader, or read it with the styles turned off, and check that everything comes in the order it is meant to be read.

rules.title: Check what each description says
rules.message: Read each picture's description with the picture in mind: does it say what the picture shows or does, in this place?

rules.title: Check that colour is not the only signal
rules.message: Look for anything said only by colour, such as a red word for wrong or a green line for done, and add words, a symbol or a pattern.

rules.title: Try it with the keyboard alone
rules.message: Move through it with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and the arrow keys: can everything be reached and used, in a sensible order, and can you always see where you are?

rules.title: Check the captions against the sound
rules.message: Watch with the captions on: do they say what is said, who is speaking and the sounds that matter, in time?

rules.title: Check for flashing
rules.message: Make sure that nothing flashes more than three times in a second.
